metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/deployment -- 409 conflict from a duplicate create against an already-existing deployment. The deployment uuid embedded in the server's free-text error message is not touched by the standard key-based anonymizer (it lives inside a message string, not a dedicated uuid-shaped field), so it was manually aligned here to the same anonymized deployment uuid (bc75eecb_bacf_4938_9c7d_6295ce0b5446) used consistently by the sibling updates_deployment_get.json/updates_deployment_create.json fixtures, in place of the real captured uuid.

body.message: Deployment with deployment uuid 1bc333e5-b6ed-b450-37c4-0007f627bd62 already exists.
